name: comfyui-image-gen
description: Generate and edit images with ComfyUI on your own GPU. Installs and runs ComfyUI for you; settings open from the tray icon.
long_description: Image generation for Claude Desktop through a ComfyUI it installs, starts and stops on your computer. Pick your GPU and install ComfyUI from the settings page (tray icon, or the link in the first tool answer); models download on first use. For claude.ai and your phone, use a Worker install of Comfy-Gen-MCP instead.

tools.name: generate_illustrated_image
tools.description: Generate an anime or illustration image

tools.name: generate_realistic_image
tools.description: Generate a realistic or general-purpose image

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Edit an image by its path on this computer, or a URL

tools.name: fetch_result
tools.description: Fetch the result of a generation that is still running
